verdict.rationale: GitLab markets Duo agents that 'review code while your team stays in control' and surfaces security findings directly in merge requests, indicating AI-assisted review is a real feature, but the evidence is limited to marketing copy without deeper docs on fix-suggestion mechanics, configuration, or independent hands-on validation. missing for 10: detailed docs/tutorial on AI reviewer workflow and suggested-fix application, independent/community confirmation of quality and reliability of AI review suggestions.
